title: Fitbit by Google Charge 6 Activity Tracker $132.54 Delivered @ Amazon Germany via AU
body:
Deal: Fitbit by Google Charge 6 Activity Tracker $132.54 Delivered @ Amazon Germany via AU

[poxy001] Not sure if its possible to price beat with Officeworks for further discount.
They might cry because its not Amazon AU but worth a crack.
[hollykryten] I once tried with JB price beating an item from Amazon Germany (through the Amazon AU web site) and was quickly turned down saying because it's a grey import. But Officeworks is probably the same no grey import price matching. As soon as they see the seller as Amazon Germany.
[HaydosK] Officeworks is much more strict. Whenever I go it takes like 20 minutes for them to check the listing. Jbhifi they don't care and normally just say yeah whatever.
[G-Shock] 28 degrees price protection easy AF no hoops.
btw just get the Fitbit air and don't bother with that shit. No one wants the charge as their watch.
[M00Cow] 6 months of premium membership included
that's the big problem, subscription to unlock features.
[hollykryten] Subscription geez that's crap. Why does Google have that. I bought a Samsung Galaxy Fit 3 band and there was no subscription required had all features. Worked straight out of the box.
[visitorsonlyparking] It's AI coaching/analysis of your data and workout videos so nothing too major
[THEMAN_AUS] I wanted a fitbit air but there's so much discourse about how inaccurate it is. :/
[Allaboutdiscounts] Oh, I didn't know about this. Maybe the new Garmin Cirqa will be better.
[Aftos] Get a Garmin. Had both, prefer the Garmin
[hotrod01] Cheap alternative samsung fit 3 with 7 day battery life however best suited to a samsung phone.
